notes.title: Patch 1.11.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41246853/9b9b526051bb046f8a323d3ddadb539ccfb6fcdd.png[/img]

Hello aviators!

We've been beavering away in the background again and squashing as many bugs as we can find. From here on out we'll be posting patch notes via Steam and keeping discord exclusively for feedback and discusison about the game.

[b]This week we have couple of fixes for you.[/b]

[list]
[*] FIXED: Crash to Desktop when a new Controller is connected
[*] FIXED: If no controllers are detected when the game starts up, it will not detect newly added controllers until restart.
[*] FIXED: volumetric clouds appearing in synthetic vision
[*] FIXED: Stall warning playing repeatedly after exiting a stall state
[*] FIXED: HOTAS pitch not responding while in freelook mode
[*] FIXED: Female passenger agitation being observed on Cargo Boxes
[*] FIXED: Pilot & cargo mass never actually being removed when exiting the vehicle or resetting/respawning the vehicle.
[*] FIXED: Clients Hear Host Instrument SFX
[*] FIXED: Client force respawn (backspace) triggers camera fade FX on Host
[*] FIXED: Default camera rotations only update after Free Look is toggled
[*] FIXED: Death state doesn't reset (after death, can't die from falling again)
[*] FIXED: Missing font on Propeller Status widget
[*] New Main menu variant (Showroom)
[*] Exit to main menu now plays a camera fade
[/list]

As always, don't forget to delete your Savegames from previous versions as these will NOT be compatible with the current version.
You can find the savegames under the following directory "C:\Users<<WindowsProfileName>>\AppData\Local\Nextera"

For more details visit our [url=https://trello.com/b/E3hTJWiM/nextera-public-roadmap]Public Roadmap[/url] on trello.

Also, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/C4gUCYMWHC]Discord Server[/url] to give feedback, chat to the devs or just talk about aviation in general.

Have fun!
